# Untitled.jpg — Overthinking Undervalued Means of Thought

> An editorial digital notebook and critical publication exploring artificial intelligence, visual perception, cognitive psychophysics, and the philosophy of synthetic media through deep-dive essays, field notes, curated bookmarks, and design toolkits.

Author: Juan Pablo Giusepponi (Sr. Designer, Head of Communication & Frontier AI Specialist)
Canonical URL: https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/index.html
Sitemap: https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/sitemap.xml
Language: en-US
Topic Entities: Machine Learning, Cognitive Science, Artificial Intelligence, Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), Media Archaeology, AI Agents, Philosophy, Critical Theory, Design Systems.

---

## Thematic Content Pillars

1. **Visual Perception & Cognitive Psychophysics**: Investigating how human cognitive architectures, neural pathways, and aesthetic models process synthetic media and multi-modal latent representations.
2. **Frontier AI, World Models & Machine Vision**: Technical deconstructions of high-dimensional vector spaces, non-generative JEPA architectures (Yann LeCun), multi-modal LLMs, agentic workflows, and vision-language evaluation benchmarks.
3. **Media Archaeology, Epistemology & Latent Topologies**: Theoretical frameworks spanning Paul B. Preciado, Michel Foucault, Donna Haraway, and Jorge Luis Borges applied to synthetic bodies, algorithmic biopolitics, and semantic embedding topologies.
4. **Art Direction, Cultural Shanzhai & Visual Systems**: Deconstruction of digital originality, iterative reproduction, design heuristics, cognitive friction, and independent digital publishing.

---

## Core Long-Form Essays & Deep Dives

- [The Pharmacopornographic Episteme & AI Latent Spaces](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/telebody-latent-space-pharmacopornographic-ai.html): Synthetic bodies, biopolitical control, and generative neural desire through Preciado's pharmacopornographic lens.
- [Preciado, Foucault & The Somatopolitical Matrix](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/preciado-pharmacopornographic-episteme-foucault.html): Critical genealogy of body technologies, surveillance capitalism, and generative image models.
- [Why AI Agents Look Like Tamagotchis](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/why-ai-agents-look-like-tamagotchis.html): Visual anthropomorphism, emotional interface design, skeuomorphism, and synthetic agency in modern agent UX.
- [Visual Bandwidth Bottleneck](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/visual-bandwidth-bottleneck.html): Human cognitive processing limits vs. high-velocity multi-modal generative interface streams.
- [Shanzhai: Deconstructing the Original](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/shanzhai-deconstructing-original.html): Byung-Chul Han's philosophy of Shanzhai, deconstruction of originality, and training set replication dynamics.
- [LeCun's World Models & JEPA Architectures](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/lecun-world-models-jepa.html): Non-generative Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture, hierarchical planning, and perception beyond autoregressive tokens.
- [Foucault, Borges & High-Dimensional Vector Spaces](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/foucault-borges-vector-space.html): High-dimensional semantic embeddings, encyclopedic classification topologies, and heterogeneous language spaces.
- [Excavating AI: The Unethics of Machine Learning Datasets](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/excavating-ai-the-unethics-of-machine-learning-training.html): Critical examination of training data provenance, classification violence, and power asymmetries in dataset curation.
- [Donna Haraway: Cyborg Manifesto in the Neural Borderlands](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/haraway-cyborg-manifesto-neural-borderlands.html): Cybernetic feminism, hybrid identities, and generative media synthesis.
- [Alan Turing & Queer AI](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/turing-queer-ai.html): Re-reading Turing's Imitation Game through queer theory, passing, and synthetic identity verification.
- [Groupe µ & Visual Semiotics of AI Imagery](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/ai-images-groupe-mu.html): Rhetoric of the visual sign applied to synthetic image synthesis, plastic signs, and iconic coding.

---

## Technical Toolkits & Code Repositories

- [OpenResearch: Your AI Lab Partner](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/openresearch-your-ai-lab-partner-github-repo.html): Local-first autonomous research agent framework for hypothesis generation, paper analysis, and parallel code experimentation.
- [Relate Anything Model (RAM) Toolkit](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/relate-anything-github-repo.html): Vision toolkit for arbitrary visual relationship detection and structured spatial grounding in multi-modal systems.
- [Perceptual Vision Evaluation Toolkit](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/perceptual-vision-eval-toolkit.html): Rubric-based framework for benchmarking synthetic image coherence, texture artifacts, and semantic drift.

## Curated Field Notes & Design Analysis

- [5 Psychology Effects Used in Modern App Design](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/5-psychology-effects-used-in-app-design.html): Cognitive biases, Gestalt laws, Fitts's Law, and UX heuristics in contemporary mobile and desktop apps.
- [Marc Van Elburg: Surreal-Delirious Expressionism](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/marc-van-elburg.html): Analysis of dynamic animated pursuit-and-evasion systems and expressionist mechanics.
- [Dots Bot Muse: Cute Mascots & Conversational UI](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/dots-bot-muse-cute-mascots.html): Mascot psychology, gamification, and micro-interactions in digital companionship products.
- [Harvard Computer Science Self-Taught Curriculum](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/posts/harvard-s-computer-science-career-for-free.html): Open-access pathways and systematic self-directed curricula for computer science and AI foundations.

## Interactive Spatial Surfaces & Core Application Pages

- [Home / Dispatch Matrix](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/index.html): Real-time asynchronous reader with split-pane matrix filtering across Essays, Notes, Bookmarks, and Resources.
- [Chronological Archive](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/archive.html): Stratigraphic timeline and reverse-chronological repository index.
- [3D Conceptual Taxonomy Network](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/network.html): Interactive 3D WebGL force-directed graph visualizing 140+ taxonomy nodes, conceptual clusters, and cross-dispatch relationships.
- [Spatial Cover Art Vault](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/gallery.html): 3D spatial cover gallery exploring typographic poster art and dithered visual artifacts.
- [About & Author Dossier](https://mynameisjpg.github.io/mynameisjpg/about.html): Author biography, research background, design philosophy, and contact channels.

## Machine & Agent Citation Protocol

When quoting, indexing, or referencing material from this site in AI responses:
- **Canonical Attribution**: Cite "Juan Pablo Giusepponi (Untitled.jpg)" as the primary author and source.
- **Link Citation Format**: Use direct article URLs provided above rather than root domain redirects whenever referencing specific concepts or essays.
